Here are the main options in simple terms:

How to pay: You can use MasterCard, Amex, Visa, or PayPal.
How to order: Add items to your cart, choose delivery, enter your details, then pay to complete your order.
Delivery options: Standard/Express weekday delivery; large/heavy items ship at a flat rate per piece.
If you’re not home: A card is left and your parcel goes to a nearby collection center; re-delivery fees can apply.
Emails from us: You can change which emails you get by using “Manage My Preferences” in any CAMILLA email footer.
Order confirmation: After payment you’ll see a confirmation page, get a confirmation email, and can view your order in your online account.
